article.title: Recovery of money from insurer as arrear of land revenue.
article.content: Where any amount is due from any person under an award, the Claims Tribunal may, on an application made to it by the person entitled to the amount, issue a certificate for the amount to the Collector and the Collector shall proceed to recover the same in the same manner as an arrear of land revenue.
article.html:
174Recovery of money from insurer as arrear of land revenue.

Section 174 · Chapter XII · page 99 of the Act

Where any amount is due from any person under an award, the Claims Tribunal may, on an application made to it by the person entitled to the amount, issue a certificate for the amount to the Collector and the Collector shall proceed to recover the same in the same manner as an arrear of land revenue.
